about.title: Where service still matters.
text: At Grant's Service Company we believe in empowering homeowners through education, not pressure. With modern tools and full transparency, we keep you informed every step of the way, so you feel confident, supported and in control of your home's comfort decisions.
We build lasting relationships by consistently doing what is right. "Where Service Still Matters" isn't just a slogan — it's how we do business every day.
We serve customers across the greater Houston area from Texas City, and we are licensed in Texas under TACLA 132807C.
